top_gear_ratio.notes: The official Audi 09/2019, 07/2024 and 06/2025 Q3 Sportback technical data (Program for Germany) list 0.561 as the top gear for the 35 TDI.

gear_ratios.notes: The official Audi 09/2019, 07/2024 and 06/2025 Q3 Sportback technical data (Program for Germany) list the forward ratios 3.579 / 2.750 / 1.677 / 0.889 / 0.677 / 0.722 / 0.561 for the 35 TDI.

final_drive_front.notes: The official Audi 09/2019, 07/2024 and 06/2025 Q3 Sportback technical data (Program for Germany) list the 35 TDI. Audi prints two gearbox output final drives, 4.813 (1-2) and 3.667 (2-3), not front and rear axle ratios. Of every way to run the forward ratios 3.579 / 2.750 / 1.677 / 0.889 / 0.677 / 0.722 / 0.561 through the two outputs, only those with the top gear on 3.667 keep the overall ratios falling gear by gear, so 3.667 is the final drive behind the top gear and is the only one stored.

verification_notes.note: The official Audi 09/2019, 07/2024 and 06/2025 Q3 Sportback technical data (Program for Germany) list the 35 TDI (in-line four TDI, 1968 cc). The 09/2019 launch sheet prints the same forward ratios and the same 1-2 output (4.813) as the 2024 and 2025 sheets. The Germany-program launch sheets are dated September 2019 (after July), so the row starts in 2020. Audi MediaCenter lists the model as 'Q3 Sportback (until 2025)' and its last sheets are dated 06/2025, so the row ends in 2025.
